note: Pork and beef meatballs in a creamy mushroom and Dijon sauce

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat gently

steps.text: Season the mince and roll into 20 balls, pressing a thumb dent into each.
Bake at 220C until browned.
Fry the mushrooms in a wide pan, then add the stock, cream and Dijon and simmer.
Add the meatballs and simmer through.

note: Panko crumbed prawns fried golden, with sweet chili sauce and lime

steps.text: Butterfly the prawns.
Dip in flour, then egg, then panko.
Fry at 180C in batches until golden.
Drain and serve hot with sweet chilli sauce and lime wedges.

note: Dark rye fingers with smoked salmon, crème fraîche, capers and dill

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Butter the rye.
Top with creme fraiche, smoked salmon, a few capers and dill sprigs.
Cut into fingers with a sharp knife and serve cold on a dark plate.

note: Firm lime jelly cut into jagged shards, served with whipped cream

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Soften the gelatine leaves in cold water.
Dissolve the jelly crystals in the boiling water and stir in the squeezed gelatine.
Pour into a lined slab tin and chill until firm.
Cut into jagged shards, pile on a plate and serve with whipped cream.

note: Coconut panko prawns with pineapple, red onion, chili and lime salsa

steps.text: Mix the coconut and panko. Dip the prawns in flour, egg, then the crumb mix.
Dice the pineapple, red onion and chilli and mix with lime juice for a salsa.
Fry the prawns at 180C in batches.
Serve together.

note: Egg yolk mayo topped with salmon roe, plus prosciutto wrapped asparagus

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the eggs hard, cool, peel and halve.
Mash the yolks with the mayo and Dijon, pipe back into the whites and top with salmon roe.
Blanch the asparagus.
Wrap each spear in half a slice of prosciutto.

note: Coconut panko prawns and thin fried plantain chips with sweet chili sauce

steps.text: Mix the coconut and panko. Dip the prawns in flour, egg, then the crumb mix.
Peel the plantains and slice thin.
Fry the prawns at 180C in batches.
Fry the plantain slices until crisp.
Serve both with sweet chilli.

note: Rockmelon cubes wrapped in prosciutto with basil, balsamic and olive oil

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Peel and seed the rockmelon and cut into 20 cubes.
Tear the prosciutto in half lengthways.
Wrap each cube in prosciutto with a basil leaf tucked inside and spear with a pick.
Arrange on a platter, drizzle with balsamic and olive oil and finish with pepper.

note: Coconut panko prawns with a mango, chili and lime dip

steps.text: Butterfly the prawns. Mix the panko and coconut.
Dip in flour, egg, then the coconut crumb.
Blitz the mango with a little chilli and lime for the dip.
Fry at 180C in batches until golden.

note: Chickpea hummus topped with crisp spiced lamb mince, pine nuts and flatbread

dish.make_ahead: Hummus up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Blitz the chickpeas with the tahini, garlic, lemon juice, salt and ice water until very smooth.
Fry the lamb in a little oil until crisp, adding the cumin, cinnamon and paprika.
Toast the pine nuts and warm the flatbreads.
Swirl the hummus onto a plate and spoon the hot lamb over.
Add pine nuts, chilli oil and parsley.

note: Crisp wonton cups with soy and sesame sashimi tuna, smashed avocado and sesame

dish.make_ahead: Tuna mix up to 1 hour ahead, assemble to serve

steps.text: Fry the wonton wrappers at 180C until crisp. Drain.
Dice the tuna and dress with soy, sesame oil, lime juice and spring onion.
Smash the avocado.
Spoon the tuna onto the wontons and top with a dot of avocado and the sesame.

note: Puff pastry rolls with tomato paste, ham, pineapple and mozzarella

dish.make_ahead: Roll up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Lay the pastry flat and spread each sheet with tomato paste.
Scatter with the ham, pineapple and mozzarella.
Roll up tightly and slice into 2cm pinwheels.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

note: Chopped griddled beef and onion with American cheese in hero rolls, lettuce and tomato

steps.text: Prep the lettuce and tomatoes.
Fry the mince and onion on a hot griddle, chopping it up with two spatulas, and season well.
Lay the cheese over, let it melt and chop it through.
Pile into the rolls with lettuce, tomato, ketchup and mayo.

note: the wrestler's lunch, three sandwiches deep

steps.text: Mix the mayo with the wholegrain mustard.
Toast the bread.
Build four stacks: toast, sauce, ham and Swiss, toast, sauce, ham, cheddar and pickles, then toast.
Press lightly, cut each into three fingers and pin with toothpicks.
Slice the apples and toss with lemon juice to serve alongside.

note: he has no lunch, so share yours

steps.text: Cube the cheddar.
Arrange the crackers, cheddar and salami on a shared plate in the middle of the table.

note: Mini deep dish pizzas baked in a muffin tin with sausage, mozzarella and tomato

steps.text: Knead the cornmeal into the dough and press into a 12-hole mini muffin tin.
Squeeze the sausage meat out of its casings and crumble.
Fill the cases with mozzarella, sausage and crushed tomato.
Bake at 210C until bubbling.

note: Cream and egg ham tartlets, plus cucumber rounds topped with smoked salmon

dish.make_ahead: Tartlets up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Cut rounds from the pastry and line a 12-hole tin.
Whisk the eggs with the cream, add the ham and chives and fill the cases.
Bake at 180C until set and golden.
Cut thick cucumber rounds and top with smoked salmon.

note: Golden pork dumplings steamed in the pan, soy and black vinegar dip

steps.text: Mix the soy, black vinegar and spring onion for dipping.
Fry the dumplings flat side down in a little oil until golden.
Add water, cover and steam.
Uncover and crisp again.

note: Small pizza rounds with sauce, mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni

steps.text: Heat the oven to 230C. Roll out the dough and cut into 16 rounds.
Spread each with pizza sauce, add mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni.
Bake until bubbling.
Present one to the camera with a cheesy grin before eating.
Mix the salt with the chilli powder on a saucer. Rub the glass rims with lime and dip in the salt.
Fill the glasses with ice. Add lime juice, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire to each.
Top slowly with cold lager, stir once and serve with a lime wedge.

note: Crisp potato skins with cheddar and bacon, sour cream and chives

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C until tender.
Halve and scoop out most of the flesh. Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble.
Brush with butter and crisp at 220C.
Fill with cheddar and bacon and bake until melted.
Top with sour cream and chives.

note: Toasted marshmallows dipped in dark chocolate, squashed between digestive biscuits

steps.text: Melt the chocolate in a bowl over hot water
Toast the marshmallows on sticks over the fire or a gas flame until blistered
Dip in the chocolate and squash between two biscuits. Eat while still gooey

note: Buttered white bread with mustard, ham, cheddar and pickles, wrapped to go

steps.text: Butter the bread and spread with mustard
Fill with ham, cheddar and pickles
Cut in half and wrap each tightly in wax paper

note: Slow caramelized onion sour cream dip with pretzels and potato chips

dish.n: Staff cabin onion dip and pretzels
dish.make_ahead: Dip keeps 2 days chilled

steps.text: Cook the onions in butter over low heat, stirring often, until deep brown and jammy
Cool and chop finely
Beat the sour cream with the cream cheese, Worcestershire and salt, then fold in the onions and chives
Chill the dip
Serve with pretzels and potato chips

note: Mini pizza rounds with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni

steps.text: Roll out the dough and cut into 16 rounds
Spread with sauce and top with mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni
Bake at 230C until bubbling and golden. Serve in a pizza box

note: the motel room they're forced to share

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days in a sealed container

steps.text: Chop the chocolate bars into chunks
Tip everything into a shared bowl and mix gently
Divide between four people for the motel snack break

note: Franks in cornmeal batter fried golden, served with mustard

steps.text: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a batter
Pat the franks dry and push onto sticks
Heat the oil to 180C
Dip the franks in batter and fry until deep golden
Serve with mustard

note: Cheddar cubes with salami and cherry tomatoes on toothpicks

steps.text: Cut the cheddar into 20 even cubes
Thread each onto a toothpick with a fold of salami and a cherry tomato
Lay out in two neat rows of exactly ten

note: Poached prawns served on ice with horseradish cocktail sauce and lemon

steps.text: Poach the prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel
Mix the tomato sauce with horseradish and a squeeze of lemon
Pile the prawns on crushed ice with the sauce and lemon wedges

note: Set fresh strawberry jelly topped with vanilla cream and crumbled shortbread

dish.n: Fresh strawberry jelly with vanilla cream
dish.make_ahead: Set up to 1 day ahead, whip cream on the day

steps.text: Hull and blend most of the strawberries with the sugar and lemon juice, then strain
Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water, squeeze and dissolve in a portion of the warmed puree
Stir into the rest of the puree and pour into four glasses over sliced strawberries
Chill until set
Whip the cream with vanilla paste and icing sugar, spoon on and crumble over the shortbread
Heat the milk until steaming without boiling
Add the chocolate and whisk until melted and frothy
Divide among four mugs
Softly whip the cream, spoon on top and finish with marshmallows

note: Crisp baked wings tossed in hot sauce butter, with blue cheese dip and celery

dish.make_ahead: Dry the wings overnight

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight
Bake on a rack at 220C, turning once, until crisp
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the wings through
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream for a dip
Serve with celery sticks

note: Vincent's Amsterdam story, the little differences

dish.make_ahead: Shape the patties up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Divide the mince into 12 small balls and dice the onion.
Smash the balls into thin patties on a hot griddle, salt well and flip after a minute or two.
Lay a slice of cheese on each patty to melt.
Fill soft buns with the patties, onion, pickle, mustard and a dab of mayonnaise, the way they do it in Amsterdam.

note: Jules tries Brett's tasty burger

dish.make_ahead: Teriyaki glaze up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin and brown sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Shape the beef mince into 12 small patties and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the pineapple rings until charred and cut each into 3.
Cook the patties on a hot griddle for 2 minutes a side, brush with the teriyaki and top each with a small square of cheddar.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha. Fill the slider buns with the patties, pineapple and sriracha mayonnaise and hold each together with a toothpick.

note: the opening scene at the diner, before the robbery

dish.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, buttermilk and eggs until just combined.
Rest the batter for 15 minutes (included in cook time).
Cook ladlefuls in butter in a frying pan until bubbles set, flip and cook through, keeping the stack warm.
Grill the bacon until crisp. Stack the pancakes with butter and maple syrup, with bacon on the side.

note: Crustless ham and Swiss triangles on buttered white bread with Dijon

steps.text: Butter the bread and spread with Dijon
Fill with ham and Swiss cheese
Cut off the crusts and cut into neat triangles
Serve on a plate with a glass of milk alongside

note: Brandy flamed chicken liver pâté on toasted baguette with fig jam

dish.make_ahead: Pate sets 4 hours, keeps 2 days chilled

steps.text: Sear the livers in some butter until pink inside
Flame with the brandy
Blitz with the soft butter and thyme
Set in a dish and chill
Slice and toast the baguette and spread with pate and a little fig jam

note: Barbara and Johnny's visit to their father's grave

steps.text: Boil the eggs, cool, peel and mash with the mayonnaise
Stir in the cress
Butter the bread
Make two egg-and-cress sandwiches and two ham and mustard sandwiches
Trim the crusts and cut each sandwich into four small pieces
Wrap in wax paper for a 1968-style picnic

note: Cheddar and cream cheese ball with smoked paprika, scored like a pumpkin

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day chilled

steps.text: Beat the cheddar with the cream cheese, half the paprika and the Worcestershire
Shape into a ball and chill
Score lines like a pumpkin and roll in the remaining paprika
Push a capsicum stem on top and serve with crackers

note: Wobbly set raspberry jelly

dish.make_ahead: Make a day ahead

steps.text: Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water
Blitz most of the raspberries with the sugar and water, warm until steaming and strain
Squeeze the gelatine dry and stir into the hot puree with the lemon juice
Pour into four shallow glass dishes and set in the fridge
Top with the remaining fresh raspberries

note: lingonberry and cream sauce

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with both minces, the onion, allspice and egg
Roll small
Brown in butter
Simmer in the stock and cream
Serve with lingonberry jam

note: Biscuit base, lemon condensed milk layer and raspberry jelly on top

dish.make_ahead: Make a day ahead

steps.text: Press the crushed biscuits and butter into a lined tin
Dissolve the gelatine in the hot water, mix with the condensed milk and lemon juice and spread over
Chill until set
Make the jelly as the packet says, cool completely and pour over
Chill until firm

note: Cocktail franks topped with spiced beef chili

steps.text: Brown the mince with the onion, cumin and paprika
Add the water and simmer
Simmer the franks
Tuck the franks into split mini rolls, spoon over chilli, add mustard and diced onion

note: Double fried wings in a sticky gochujang and soy glaze

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and toss in the potato starch
Fry at 160C
Rest
Fry again at 190C until very crisp
Simmer the gochujang, soy, honey and garlic until glossy
Toss the wings in the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds

note: Chewy rice cakes simmered in a gochujang sauce (tteokbokki)

steps.text: Soak the rice cakes in water
Simmer the stock with the anchovies, then add the gochujang, gochugaru and sugar
Add the rice cakes and fish cake and simmer until thick and glossy
Top with spring onion

note: Blinis with crème fraîche and smoked salmon, cucumber rounds with whipped goat's cheese

steps.text: Top the blinis with creme fraiche, smoked salmon, dill and lemon zest
Cut the cucumber into thick rounds
Whip the goat's cheese with chives and pipe onto the rounds
Lay both neatly on silver trays

note: Marshmallow bars made with colored fruit cereal, served with cold milk

steps.text: Melt the butter in a large pan and cook until it smells nutty
Add the marshmallows and salt and stir until melted
Off the heat, fold in the cereal quickly
Press into a lined 20cm square tin with a buttered spatula
Cool, then cut into 16 bars
Serve with tall glasses of cold milk, kept separate

note: Vanilla bean panna cotta set in teacups

dish.make_ahead: Make a day ahead

steps.text: Soak the gelatine leaves
Warm the cream with most of the sugar and the split vanilla bean, then stir in the squeezed gelatine
Pour into four teacups and set
Simmer the berries with a spoon of sugar and spoon on top
Serve with silver spoons

note: Tiny egg and cress, cucumber cream cheese and ham Dijon sandwiches

steps.text: Boil the eggs, cool, peel and mash with the mayo and cress
Make egg sandwiches, cucumber and cream cheese sandwiches, and ham and Dijon sandwiches
Cut off the crusts and cut into exact little squares
Stand them up in rows

note: Shredded poached chicken and jasmine rice in lettuce leaves with lime and fish sauce

dish.n: Lettuce leaf chicken and rice cups

steps.text: Poach the chicken in simmering salted water, rest, then shred
Cook the rice
Mix the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chilli for the dressing
Separate the lettuce into cups
Fill each with rice, chicken, cucumber, mint and coriander, spoon over the dressing and finish with peanuts

note: Navy beans baked slowly with speck and molasses, served on toast

dish.make_ahead: Soak the beans the night before. Cooked beans keep 3 days chilled

steps.text: Soak the beans overnight (not counted in the time)
Simmer the beans
Bake at 150C with the speck, onion, molasses, mustard powder and enough water to cover
Toast the sourdough and butter it
Spoon the beans over the toast

note: the dinner party prawns grab the guests' faces

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days, prawns poached up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Poach the prawns in salted simmering water for 2 minutes until just cooked.
Chill in iced water, then drain well.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon and hot sauce.
Shred half the lettuce into four glasses, pile in the prawns and spoon the sauce over.

note: Dry-brined pork rind roasted until blistered and crisp, with flaky salt

dish.make_ahead: Dry the rind overnight. Best eaten the same day

steps.text: Score the rind and rub with flaky salt
Dry uncovered in the fridge overnight
Roast at 240C until blistered and crisp all over
Cool, then break into pieces. Stay on the road

note: Soft boiled eggs wrapped in sausage, crumbed and fried, with English mustard

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day chilled

steps.text: Boil four eggs, cool and peel
Wrap each in seasoned sausage mince
Roll in flour, the beaten egg and panko
Fry at 170C
Halve and serve with English mustard

note: Seared garlic butter sirloin cubes with a horseradish sour cream dip

steps.text: Cut the steak into cubes and season well
Sear in a smoking pan in batches
Baste with the butter, garlic and thyme
Rest
Mix the sour cream with the horseradish and serve with the steak on toothpicks

note: Saucy beef mince on slider buns with cheddar and dill pickles

steps.text: Dice the onion and capsicum
Brown the mince with the onion and capsicum
Add the sauce, Worcestershire, sugar, mustard and water and simmer until thick
Split the buns and lay half a slice of cheddar on each base
Spoon on the mince and top with pickles

note: Egg and cress, cucumber cream cheese and smoked salmon finger sandwiches

steps.text: Boil the eggs, cool, peel and mash with mayo and cress
Make cucumber and cream cheese, egg, and smoked salmon and dill sandwiches
Cut off the crusts and cut into fingers
Lay on a tiered stand

note: Lemon chive crab mayo and cucumber on soft white bread, crusts off

steps.text: Mix the crab with the mayonnaise, lemon zest, a squeeze of juice, chives and pepper
Butter the bread
Spread the crab over half the slices and lay thin cucumber on top
Close with the remaining bread, press gently, trim off the crusts and cut each into three fingers

note: Taco shells with seasoned beef, lettuce and cheddar, red pepper tongues

steps.text: Brown the mince with the taco spices
Shred the lettuce and cut the capsicum into strips
Warm the shells
Fill with mince, lettuce and cheddar
Hang a strip of red capsicum out of each like a tongue

note: Warm orange olives, salami, provolone, pickles, artichokes and grissini

steps.text: Warm the olives in the oil with orange peel, garlic and chilli flakes, then cool
Slice the salami and provolone
Arrange on a big board in tidy rows with the olives, giardiniera, artichokes, grissini and cornichons
Serve at room temperature

note: Mini hot dogs simmered in a sweet tomato and mustard glaze

steps.text: Simmer the franks in the sauce, sugar, mustard and water, stirring until sticky and glossy
Pile into a warm bowl with toothpicks for picking

note: Sliced smoked sausage and cubed cheese with pickled onions on picks

steps.text: Slice the kabana on the diagonal
Cut the cheese into cubes
Thread onto toothpicks with pickled onions
Lay out on a plastic platter with crackers. It is the vibe

note: Peeled king prawns on crushed ice with creamy tomato sauce and lemon

steps.text: Peel the prawns, leaving the tails on
Pile on crushed ice
Mix the mayo, tomato sauce, Worcestershire and a squeeze of lemon
Serve with lemon wedges, and put the platter in the pool room after

note: Thick chips tossed in chicken salt, with gravy for dipping

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips and dry
Fry at 140C until cooked through
Fry again at 190C until golden
Toss in chicken salt
Whisk the gravy powder into the boiling water
Serve in butcher's paper with gravy for dipping
Boil the diced potatoes for 6 minutes, then drain.
Fry the onion in the butter until soft.
Add the potato and break in the corned beef, press flat and fry without stirring until crusty, then turn and repeat.
Fry the eggs.
Serve the hash in clean empty tins with an egg on top.

note: Beer battered chips tossed in chicken salt, with garlic mayo

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips and parboil, then drain and steam dry
Whisk the flour with the cold lager and salt
Dip the chips in the batter
Fry in batches at 180C until golden
Drain and toss with chicken salt
Mix the mayonnaise with garlic and lemon juice for dipping

note: Scallops in curry cream in a shortcrust pie with a puff pastry lid

steps.text: Soften the onion in butter
Add the curry powder and cream and simmer until thick
Stir in the scallops off the heat and cool
Line patty tins with shortcrust and fill
Top with puff
Bake at 200C

note: Prawns on shredded iceberg with creamy tomato cocktail sauce

dish.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day, assemble just before serving

steps.text: Peel the prawns, keeping them chilled.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce, hot sauce and a squeeze of lemon.
Shred the lettuce into four glasses, pile on the prawns and spoon over the sauce. Hang a lemon wedge on each rim.

note: Puff pastry cases filled with creamy chicken, mushroom and tarragon

dish.make_ahead: Cases up to 1 day, fill and warm to serve

steps.text: Thaw the pastry. Cut 16 rounds, press a smaller cutter into each, and place on trays.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden, then push the centres down.
Dice the chicken and chop the mushrooms. Fry both in the butter until cooked.
Add the cream, tarragon and a squeeze of lemon and simmer until thick.
Fill the cases and warm through in the oven.

note: Blinis with smoked salmon and crème fraîche, cucumber cups with whipped goat's cheese

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Top the blinis with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill.
Cut the cucumber into thick rounds, scoop a small hollow in each and whip the goat's cheese smooth.
Fill the cucumber cups with the cheese and lay everything on trays.

film: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert (1994)
note: Pork sausage rolls in puff pastry with sesame seeds, tomato sauce

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, or freeze

steps.text: Grate the onion and carrot and mix through the sausage mince with the herbs.
Lay the mince along each pastry sheet, roll up, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Cut into 16 pieces and bake at 200C until puffed and golden. Serve with tomato sauce.

note: Sliced corned silverside with English mustard and pickles on buttered bread

dish.make_ahead: Beef up to 3 days, assemble on the day

steps.text: Put the beef in a pot with the halved onion, carrot and peppercorns, cover with water and bring to a simmer.
Simmer gently, then leave to cool in the liquid.
Butter the bread, slice the beef thin and layer with mustard and pickles.

note: the giant sundae he builds watching a gangster film

steps.text: Take the vanilla and chocolate ice cream out of the freezer to soften for 10 minutes.
Melt the dark chocolate with 150ml of the thickened cream over low heat, stirring, for hot fudge.
Whip the rest of the cream to soft peaks.
Chop the roasted peanuts and put them, the mini marshmallows, sprinkles and maraschino cherries in small bowls.
Set everything out with big bowls and let everyone build their own sundae.
